governance_rules: 1. AGENTS.md and living knowledge vault rules are strictly authoritative.
2. Never invent citations, datasets, DOIs, or license terms.
3. Never promote derived narrative to canonical evidence.
5. No external writes/downloads without existing project gates.
6. Auto-update is permanently disabled for reproducibility.

skills.purpose: Audit manuscript statistical reporting, replication, CI, effect sizes, and tests
skills.overlap_with_existing: Complements existing validation contracts by providing manuscript-level reporting checks
skills.unique_value: Standardized reporting checklist for effect size, uncertainty bounds, and design units
skills.adoption_reason: High relevance to seed consistency, confidence intervals, and 2x2 factorial interaction reporting
